harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «له الملك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the Divine Name, and the clause «وهو على كل شيء قدير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «له الملك».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «هو الذي» is resumptive; the clause «فمنكم كافر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «هو الذي»; the clause «والله بصير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «خلق» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق»; the clause «وصوَّركم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «خلق»; the clause «فأحسن» is conjoined to the clause «صوَّركم»; and the clause «وإليه المصير» is conjoined to the clause «خلق».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «والله عليم» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بذات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من قبل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يأتكم»; the clause «فذاقوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كفروا»; the clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «ذاقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: (ذلك بأنه كانت تأتيهم رسلهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the hāʾ is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the noun of «كانت» is the pronoun of the story (ḍamīr al-qiṣṣa), and the clause «تأتيهم رسلهم» is the khabar of «كانت»; it is weak to take «رسلهم» as the noun of kāna and the clause «تأتيهم» as the khabar, because the khabar of a mubtadaʾ (subject), when it is a verbal clause, does not precede the mubtadaʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «بالبينات» is attached to «تأتيهم»; the clause «فقالوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «كانت»; the clause «يهدوننا» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, even though it is most common for the hamza to be followed by a verb; the clause «فكفروا» is conjoined to the clause «قالوا»; the clause «واستغنى الله» is conjoined to the clause «تولَّوا»; the pronoun in «يهدوننا» is plural because «البشر» is a generic noun (ism jins).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «أن» is lightened from the heavy [أنَّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); the clause «لن يبعثوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن», and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of «أن» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «زعم»; the clause «بلى وربي لتبعثن» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «لتبعثن» is the answer to the oath; and the clause «وذلك على الله يسير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «فآمنوا» is resumptive; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause «والله خبير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «يوم» is the object of the implied verb «اذكر» (remember); the clause «ذلك يوم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «يوم الجمع»; the conditional clause is resumptive; «جنات» is a second object; «أبدا» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين»; the clause «ذلك الفوز» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «والذين كفروا..» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمَنْ يُؤْمِنْ} and has no grammatical position; the clause «أولئك أصحاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; the clause «وبئس المصير» is resumptive, and the one specified [for blame] (al-makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e.: the Fire.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: His words «مصيبة»: the fāʿil (agent) of «أصاب», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the object is omitted, its implied form being "أحدًا" (anyone); the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مصيبة»; the conditional clause is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله بكل شيء عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «وأطيعوا» is resumptive; the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause; the preposition and its genitive noun «على رسولنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «البلاغ».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: (الله لا إله إلا هو) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause of transcendence is the khabar (predicate); the clause «وعلى الله فليتوكل» is resumptive; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتوكل».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «إن من أزواجكم», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدوا»; the clause «فاحذروهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause of the answer to the vocative; the conditional clause is conjoined to the answer to the vocative; «رحيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «إنما» is a restraining [particle] and restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); the clause «والله عنده أجر» is resumptive; the clause «عنده أجر» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is resumptive; «ما» is maṣdariyya and temporal (maṣdariyya ẓarfiyya), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ما استطعتم» is accusative as an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اتقوا», the implied form being: for the duration of your ability; «خيرا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a good spending, its adjective standing in for it. «شح» is a second object; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «قرضا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause «والله شكور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: His words «عالم»: a third khabar (predicate) of the Divine Name, and «العزيز الحكيم» are further khabars.
